sloka: क्रव्यादानाम् च सर्वेषम् माभूत्पुत्रक ते भयम् ।प्लवगा वृश्चिका दम्शा मशकाः चैव कानने ॥२-२५-१८॥
transliteration: kravyādānām ca sarveṣam mābhūtputraka te bhayam ।plavagā vṛścikā damśā maśakāḥ caiva kānane ॥2-25-18॥

translations.english: May monkeys, scorpions, wild gnats, mosquitoes, reptiles and insects in that inaccessible forest not trouble you
